title: Suspicious Whisker Activity
description: Suspicious Whisker Activity — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Illiot Fess - Kingdom Agent

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with Agent Hammer on Level 1 of Algernon about the increase in organized Whisker activity.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Illiot Fess - Kingdom Agent

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Fizz Water Burn

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Speak with Agent Hammer on Level 1 of Algernon about the increase in organized Whisker activity.

Offer:

Oh good! You must be the Agent I sent for. Even if you're not, I can still use you. You don't appear to be especially busy, so you can do me this favor! Great!

The Whiskers in Algernon have been acting strangely--well, stranger than normal. Ever since the Fizz Rock mines in Dew Valley went bust, Whiskers have been pouring into Algernon. We tried sprays and traps--we even bought a large Warg to chase them, but then had to train a Mutant to hunt the Warg and then...well, it got out of hand pretty fast.

Anyway, I sent an undercover agent into Algernon to find out just what is going on, I need you to find him and get a status report.

I don't think I need to remind you that this mission is of utmost secrecy. The cover of my agents cannot be compromised in any way. Agent Hammer has worked tirelessly to establish his cover. He went above and beyond, even altering his appearance, so you may not notice him at first.

Turn-in:

Shhhhhh! Not so loud, you'll blow my cover!

Level range: 3–20
